agent_responses.response_str:
To search for a one-stop flight, please provide:

- Departure airport or city
- Destination airport or city
- Travel date
- One-way or round trip
- Return date, if round trip
- Number of travelers and passenger types (adult, child, infant)
- Cabin class
- Any preferred departure/arrival times
- Whether “one-stop” means exactly one stop or up to one stop

Optional: preferred airline, budget, and baggage needs.
